messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate detected for smart-routing fallback group in eu-west-1 (multiple 502/503s from runtime). Impacting subset of model variants that support tool-calls. please ack if oncall.

mira: acked. i'm oncall. seeing spike on /v1/generate for customers using tool-calling enabled routes.

jon: i'm watching infra. looks like routing policy started shifting traffic from eu-west to eu-central as a fallback, but several eu-central hosts returned model-compat errors and then retriggered fallback back to eu-west -> loop.

sahil: quick summary from runtime logs: model-availability check failed for quantized variants in eu-central because the compatibility matrix flagged them as fp16-only. requests that require tool-calls were being routed to a variant that doesn't advertise tool_call capability = true. runtime then rejects and fallback sends it back. loop.

leah: ugh. that sounds like a bad merge in the compat matrix config from last night. i merged a patch that canonicalized variant capabilities, maybe defaulting tool_call to false for quantized variants.

kevin: customers reporting timeouts and elevated 5xxs. CS ticket #CS-1421 from Acme reports operations degraded for last ~10m.

eva: flagged to acct team. Acme is on a dedicated SLA; raising severity to P1 internally. drafting short note for them.

mira: immediate mitigation proposals: 1) enable routing circuit-breaker for eu-west so fallback doesn't re-enter same cluster 2) temporarily pin fallback policy to model_variant=fp16 for routes with tool_call=true 3) roll back compat matrix change. which is fastest?

jon: circuit-breaker toggle is fastest. i can flip the feature flag to stop cross-region bounce. command: 
```
rbctl feature-toggle set smart_routing.circuit_breaker.eu-west true --by=incident
```
I'll do that now and monitor.

sahil: meanwhile i'll push a temporary compat-matrix patch that forces tool_call=true for the known quant+tool variants in eu-central until we do a proper fix. small json diff: 
```
- "variant_qa_quant_v2": { "precision": "quant", "tool_call": false }
+ "variant_qa_quant_v2": { "precision": "quant", "tool_call": true }
```
Note: this is a hotpatch, needs approval from leah.

leah: i approve the hotpatch. go ahead. also open a PR for the canonical fix.

jon: circuit-breaker is flipped. traffic bounce rate dropped immediately in metrics, error spikes trending down. logs show far fewer model_compat rejection reasons.

mira: applying runtime override to pin fallback to fp16 for tool-call routes: 
```
rbctl routing override set --scope=eu-west --route-filter="tool_call==true" --pin-variant=fp16-temp-2026-03-15
```
This will prevent quantized variants from being selected as fallback for the critical routes.

kevin: CS update draft: "We've identified a routing config mismatch that incorrectly routed tool-calling requests to incompatible variants and triggered a redundant region fallback loop. We've applied mitigations and are monitoring. We'll follow up with a root cause and timeline for fix." ok to send? :thumbsup:

eva: send it. add that we will follow up with an ETA for a permanent compat-matrix fix and test plan.

sahil: hotpatch deployed to config store and runtime picked it up. i see successful model_compat checks now for eu-central quant variants. still monitoring for regressions.

jon: monitoring shows 5xx rate back to baseline for impacted routes, error budget usage normalized. setting incident state to mitigating.

mira: moving to an oncall handoff. jon take lead for postmortem and RCA, sahil keep the compat-matrix changes and PR. leah coordinate release/rollout. i'll remain point for customer comms.

jon: ack. i'll open incident ticket INC-2487654321, capture timeline, attach logs and the diff for the compat-matrix hotpatch. assigning follow-ups: 
- sahil: revert hotpatch + replace with canonical fix in PR (include unit tests for tool_call capability)
- leah: validate deploy gating and add CI test for compat-matrix merges to prevent defaulting tool_call to false
- mira: customer follow-ups and postmortem review with Acme

kevin: any ETA for full rollback to standard routing logic?

leah: once sahil's PR lands and passes CI, we can roll back routing override in ~30-45m. i'll schedule the rollout window.

sahil: drafting PR now, will include integration tests that simulate route selection given matrix entries for (precision, context_len, tool_call).

mira: thanks team. reminder to include the incident-bot timeline: 
- 2487654321 incident-bot PAGER fired -> 12:04 UTC
- circuit-breaker toggle -> 12:06 UTC (jon)
- routing override pin to fp16 -> 12:08 UTC (mira)
- compat-matrix hotpatch -> 12:10 UTC (sahil)
- error rates to baseline -> 12:12 UTC

jon: setting incident to resolved once PR merges and we remove temporary overrides. i'll follow up in INC ticket.

incident-bot: NOTE: Incident INC-2487654321 created and assigned to oncall team.

mira: closing thread here after handoff. good job. :clap:
